commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: fix(pwa): clear app badge when app is opened or becomes visible
commits.body:
iOS/iPadOS shows the count of unread notifications as a badge on the PWA
app icon. The badge was never being cleared, causing it to remain stuck.

Added useClearAppBadge hook that calls navigator.clearAppBadge() when:
- The app first loads
- The app becomes visible (user switches back to the app)
